messages:
Marta Sales: quick one — FinBank wants a VPC/on‑prem POC but procurement is asking for the first 3 months of the private platform fee to be waived to unblock budget. POC = 2 gpus, 3 months, likely 12‑month reserved commit if results look good. thoughts?
Samir Engineer: technical +1 to POC, can do install in 2 weeks if we get access to their network. need KMS details and a security questionnaire answered.
Marta Sales: they asked specifically for the platform fee waiver so legal + deal desk will need to approve. they said waiver is a showstopper.
Evan DealDesk: numbers first — our standard private platform fee SKU `PRIVATE_PLATFORM_FEE_MONTHLY` is $12,000/mo. Support tiers: `ONPREM_SILVER` $8,000/mo, `ONPREM_GOLD` $18,000/mo.
Evan DealDesk: full waiver for 3 months is material. we can consider: (A) 100% credit applied if they sign a 12‑month reserved capacity commit >= $120k ARR, or (B) 50% off for 3 months with a 6‑month minimum invoice. need CRO + finance ok.
Marta Sales: they pushed back — procurement can't do 12 months upfront without a waiver. asking for 'no platform fee for POC' and then convert to enterprise contract.
Jess Solutions: from delivery POV we can offer a trimmed POC package (no Gold support) but that increases risk. if we waive platform fee, we should require a simple POC acceptance criteria doc and a converted purchase order within X days. also we need to lock which model variants run in POC (cost control).
Samir Engineer: also require no PHI during POC and limited data retention. otherwise we need HIPAA guardrails and bigger legal review.
Legal Ops: we can sign off on a conditional credit for POC if: (1) no PHI, (2) customer signs the Data Processing Addendum + limited use clause, (3) POC acceptance criteria agreed, (4) PO or signed term sheet for follow‑on within 30 days of POC end. finance to confirm credit mechanics.
Evan DealDesk: drafting a formal exception: waive first 3 months of `PRIVATE_PLATFORM_FEE_MONTHLY` as a credit applied to invoices if customer meets the follow‑on commit of >= $100k ARR within 45 days of POC completion. If they don't commit, credit is forfeited and a one‑time invoice for waived amount will be issued.
Marta Sales: that sounds workable, procurement will eat that. can we also cap token spend during POC? customer worried about cost spikes.
Samir Engineer: yes — we'll set model/throughput limits and a soft quota alert. config snippet we can use: ```quota: {tokens_per_minute: 20000, max_tokens_total: 15_000_000}```
Procurement Bot: FYI — automated check: the proposed follow‑on threshold ($100k) triggers standard discount band 2 in our rate card; deal desk to confirm margin impact. :eyes: 
Evan DealDesk: I'll run margin calc and push to CRO for one‑time exception. if finance signs off on credit accounting we can send the exception memo to legal for approval.
Jess Solutions: ops note — if approved, we should require at least Silver support during install window (first 30 days) so we don't SLA ourselves into a hole.
Legal Ops: will prepare a redlined addendum template for the conditional credit + POC acceptance criteria. drop any customer security questions in this thread and I'll triage.
Marta Sales: thanks all — I'll send the procurement contact the conditional offer and loop in FinBank legal. ping me if you need anything to move fast. :thumbsup:
